description: Regulatory issues, enforcement actions, and material findings. Used to determine severity-based caps applied during scoring.

regulatory_issues.issue_type: [Consent Order / Enforcement Action / Material Weakness / Cyber Incident / Compliance Finding / etc.]
regulatory_issues.issue_source: [Database or document where issue found; e.g., NCUA Enforcement DB, Internal Audit]
regulatory_issues.regulatory_body: [NCUA / OCC / CFPB / Department of Justice / etc.]
regulatory_issues.affected_capabilities: [Array of P[1-4]C[1-5] impacted by this issue]
regulatory_issues.primary_capability_cap: [If S3, primary cap = 1.5; if S2, = 3.0; if S1, = none]
regulatory_issues.secondary_capability_cap: [If S3, secondary = 2.0; if S2, = 3.0; if S1, = none]
regulatory_issues.pillar_cap: [If S3, pillar cap = 2.0; if S2, = 3.5; if S1, = none]
regulatory_issues.reference_url: [URL to enforcement database entry or public filing]
regulatory_issues.internal_remediation_status: [Brief note on any remediation evidence; e.g., 'Internal audit shows corrective actions completed as of [date]']

data_breaches_and_security_incidents.data_types_exposed: [Types of data: PII, Financial, Medical, etc.]
data_breaches_and_security_incidents.cap_trigger: [Disclosed breach <12 mo → P4C4 cap 2.0; <24 mo → cap 3.0]
data_breaches_and_security_incidents.breach_evidence_source: [Breach notification database, press release, regulatory filing]

material_compliance_findings.finding_category: [AML/BSA / Consumer Compliance / Fair Lending / Data Protection / etc.]
material_compliance_findings.finding_description: [What was found and why it matters]

issue_time_map.description: Timeline of all issues to determine current exposure and cap applicability

cybersecurity_breach_caps.p4c4_cap_ceiling: [2.0 if <12 mo / 3.0 if <24 mo / None if >24 mo]

caps_triggered.severity_caps_count: [Total number of severity caps to apply]

severity_classification_validation.description: All issues classified per skill definitions: S3 = active enforcement <12 mo, S2 = material weakness/terminated <24 mo, S1 = minor/resolved

cap_calculation_validation.sample_calculation: [E.g., 'Issue ISS-001: S3 active <12 mo → Apply P3C3 cap 1.5, P3C2 cap 2.0, P3 pillar cap 2.0 ✓']

timeline_accuracy.notes: All issue dates verified against source documents; months_since calculation verified
